# Research gaps

## Gaps in this repository's evidence base

- No experiment used measured data or hardware. Every result is a simulation of an illustrative plant.
- 200 of 283 taxonomy topics are Planned (no content).
- No literature from 2022 onward is registered; the search was not performed.
- Standards were checked at catalogue level only.

## Unverified candidates

- **Smith two-point FOPDT identification (28.3 % / 63.2 %)**. Used in notebook 02. Textbooks present it, but the primary source was not located. Treat the method as standard practice, not as a cited result.
- **Blaschke 1972, field orientation (Siemens Review 34)**. Not searched in this build.
- **IEC 61508 (functional safety), IEC 61800 (adjustable speed drives), ISA-5.1, ISO 13849-1**. Named as relevant in the brief; edition and scope not verified.
- **Recent (2020 onward) papers on fuzzy PID, MPC for drives and sensorless FOC**. No recent literature was searched, so the research registers have no post-2021 papers.

## Limitations repeated across experiments

- No hardware validation. (06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12)
- Illustrative parameters; no measured data. (09, 10)
- No hardware or controller-in-the-loop validation. (01, 03)
